d: A mother of two mysteriously vanishes from her parents' Michigan home while going to check the mailbox, leaving her phone and identification behind  police declare her dead without discovering a body.

When a complicated Texas love triangle ends in murder, a pink gun leads to an arrest, until new evidence prompts investigators to rethink the case.

t: NBC Nightly News With Tom Llamas
d: Tom Llamas anchors the latest news, going beyond the headlines to see how lives are affected by the world around them.
